  <text x="24" y="133" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Forgot password?</text>
  <text x="24" y="162" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Reset your password and get back to discovering</text>

  <text x="40" y="410" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">name@example.com</text>

  <text x="24" y="464" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Use the email address linked to your IMDb account.</text>
